## Overall UK-Nordic imports

In 2025 the UK imported £`r nordic_import_total.25`m from all Nordic countries. This is up in nominal terms since 2019 by £`r nordic_import_total.25 - nordic_import_total.19`M. Overall Nordic share of UK imports is relatively small at `r nordic_import_share_uk.25`% in 2025 which is flat since 2019 however peaking in 2022 at `r nordic_import_share_uk.22`. Norway is the largest exporter into the UK of all Nordic countries, with X£m in 2025, which is up X% since 2019 but also down X% form the 2022 peak of X% due to Russian Sanctions and importation of fuels.
